# Maktabah Maftoohah (المكتبة المفتوحة)
> Open-access, zero-build, offline-first digital Islamic library ecosystem.
> Standard Malaysian Islamic nomenclature (Bahasa Melayu) & English localization.

## Collections & Repositories
- [Portal Utama / Master Catalogue](https://maktabah-maftoohah.github.io/): Comprehensive catalogue of 48 classical Islamic heritage repositories.
- [Al-Quran Digital](https://maktabah-maftoohah.github.io/al-quran/): Complete 114 Surahs, 6,236 Ayahs, word-by-word morphology, Basmeih & Sahih International translations, Tafsir Jalalayn.
- [Sahih al-Bukhari](https://maktabah-maftoohah.github.io/sahih-al-bukhari/): Complete 7,563 hadiths across 97 books, full Arabic matn & isnad, dual translations, scholarly gradings, cross-references.
- [Sahih Muslim](https://maktabah-maftoohah.github.io/sahih-muslim/): Authentic Prophetic traditions categorized across canonical books.
- [Bulugh al-Maram](https://maktabah-maftoohah.github.io/bulugh-al-maram/): Classical legal Hadith collection compiled by Ibn Hajar al-Asqalani.
- [Korpus Al-Quran](https://maktabah-maftoohah.github.io/korpus-quran/): Arabic grammar, syntax (I'rab), and 1,651 root words dictionary.
- [Prophetic Timeline](https://maktabah-maftoohah.github.io/prophetic-timeline/): Chronological interactive timeline of the Sirah Nabawiyyah.

## Data Standard & Machine Endpoints
- Master Registry: https://maktabah-maftoohah.github.io/data/catalogue.json
- Master Sitemap Index: https://maktabah-maftoohah.github.io/sitemap-index.xml
